clientJobs.sql: select count(*) as "count" from (select *, row_number() over(partition by coalesce(parent_job_id,customer_job_id) order by created_at desc,customer_job_id desc) as family_rank from "customer_jobs" where "account_id" = ? and "customer_id" = ?) as "j" inner join "customer_job_types" as "t" on "t"."job_type_id" = "j"."job_type_id" and "t"."account_id" = "j"."account_id" inner join "customer_job_categories" as "cat" on "cat"."customer_job_category_id" = "t"."customer_job_category_id" and "cat"."account_id" = "j"."account_id" inner join "customers" as "c" on "c"."customer_id" = "j"."customer_id" and "c"."account_id" = "j"."account_id" where "j"."family_rank" = ? limit ?

select "j".*, "t"."job_description", "t"."book_rate", "t"."customer_job_category_id", "cat"."customer_job_category", "c"."display_name" as "customer_name" from (select *, row_number() over(partition by coalesce(parent_job_id,customer_job_id) order by created_at desc,customer_job_id desc) as family_rank from "customer_jobs" where "account_id" = ? and "customer_id" = ?) as "j" inner join "customer_job_types" as "t" on "t"."job_type_id" = "j"."job_type_id" and "t"."account_id" = "j"."account_id" inner join "customer_job_categories" as "cat" on "cat"."customer_job_category_id" = "t"."customer_job_category_id" and "cat"."account_id" = "j"."account_id" inner join "customers" as "c" on "c"."customer_id" = "j"."customer_id" and "c"."account_id" = "j"."account_id" where "j"."family_rank" = ? order by "j"."customer_job_id" desc, "j"."customer_job_id" desc limit ?
